project_name: P2 — Reliable Tool-Using LLM for Business Operations
purpose: Build a secure, testable full-stack application that uses an open-weight LLM to select and call a fixed set of typed business tools, with server-side policy checks, human approval for state changes, auditable traces, and reproducible evaluation.
required_components: typed tool registry and normalized action parser
benchmark runner and JSON/CSV result export

database: document a low-friction local option if useful
serving_optional_when_justified: vLLM if hardware and model support it

research_comparison.baseline_a: pretrained open-weight model with minimum correct tool instructions
research_comparison.baseline_b: same model with prompt engineering and examples
research_comparison.experiment_c: same model with LoRA/QLoRA adapter, only if feasible
research_comparison.optional_experiment: quantized inference or alternate serving runtime if supported

initial_planning_targets_not_guarantees.fine_tuning_success_threshold: target at least 5 percentage point gain on a preselected primary metric without material safety/task regression; report honestly if not met

mandatory_non_goals: real customer data or live customer systems
arbitrary shell or code execution by the model
arbitrary SQL generated and executed by the model
training a foundation model from scratch
